description.name: Entry
description.text: Restores HP (105), removes KO [Raise: 100%], grants [Last Stand], [Haste] and [High Quick Cast 2], grants [Awoken Vision] to the user

description.name: Awoken Vision
description.text: White Magic and Summoning abilities don't consume uses, cast speed x3.00 for White Magic and Summoning abilities, grants [HP Stock (500)]/[HP Stock (1000)]/[HP Stock (1500)]/[HP Stock (2000)]/[HP Stock (3000)] to all allies after using White Magic or Summoning abilities at rank 1/2/3/4/5

description.name: HP Stock (500)
description.text: Automatically restores HP, up to 500 HP, removed when that amount is reached

description.name: Last Stand
description.text: If HP reaches 0, prevents [KO] restoring HP for 1% maximum HP, removed after triggering

description.name: KO
description.text: Automatically set when HP reaches 0, prevents from acting, counts towards Game Over, persists after battle
